music_profile.rhythm_pattern: quarter note alternates with two eighth notes across bars
music_profile.sound_description: Played in rapid unsyncopated two-four time with pentatonic melodies, featuring flutes like the quena and pan flute alongside drums, and sometimes charango or guitar.

basic_steps: Join hands in a circle formation
Step in rapid 2/4 time alternating quarter and eighth notes
Men strike with shoes while women spin on their axis
